diagnostics.message:
[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run1]
`null_resource.delete_daemonset` deletes the `aws-node` VPC CNI DaemonSet, which should only happen after Calico has been installed via `null_resource.create_calico_installation`. Currently it only depends on `update_kubeconfig`/`module.eks`, so Terraform may remove the VPC CNI before Calico is in place, leaving the cluster without pod networking.

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run2]
null_resource.delete_daemonset removes the `aws-node` DaemonSet to hand pod networking over to Calico, but it only depends on null_resource.update_kubeconfig and module.eks. It should also depend on null_resource.create_calico_installation (which applies the Calico Installation and brings up calico-node); otherwise Terraform may delete the VPC CNI before Calico is applied, leaving nodes without working pod networking during apply.

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run3]
null_resource.delete_daemonset removes the aws-node VPC CNI DaemonSet, but it has no dependency on null_resource.create_calico_installation. Terraform can therefore delete the existing CNI before the Calico Installation has been created, leaving the cluster without working pod networking.
